description: Budget priority through regions and spawns: a task with priority 50 opens a region whose budget sets priority 200, then spawns a child into its own region (cx.spawn: the spawner's 50), one into the region it opened (child.cx().spawn: that region's budget, meet(50, 200) = 200, priority meets upward), and one with a budget of priority 10 (scope_with_budget: 10, unclamped). The lab admits each spawn at its budget priority, so the children run 200 (t.0.in), 50 (t.0.own), then 10 (t.0.low); the spawner joins them before it closes the region, waking between them.
